text: Based on the tool outputs, there were no thermal detections for the full period of 2026-10-13 to 2026-11-12. The data shows zero detections intersecting the asset (ASSET-F14) during this time. Although there was a brief period (2026-11-02 to 2026-11-06) where the VIIRS_SNPP sensor was not available, the other sensors (VIIRS_NOAA20, VIIRS_NOAA21, and MODIS) provided continuous coverage. Thus, we can confirm the absence of thermal detections for the entire period.
